$comment: Pinned candidate SemanticScopeDescriptor, rewritten 2026-09-01 to satisfy semantic-scope-descriptor.v1.schema.json in full (the independent review found the first draft failing its own schema on 20 points and absent from schema-assertions). Normative family texts: ../package/SPEC_UVP.md, ../data/SPEC_UVD.md, ../scenario/SPEC_UVS.md, ../behavior/SPEC_UVB.md, ../campaign/SPEC_UVC.md. Executable: ../conformance/schema-assertions.json, ../conformance/uvp-composition, ../conformance/uvd-resolution, ../conformance/uvb-binary. Declared: ../conformance/uvs-uvb (verifier/kernel).
summary: The runtime semantic plane a game adapter and the deterministic kernel must agree on: composed definitions (UVD), reactive scenarios (UVS) and behavior modules (UVB) packaged as UVP and addressed through one versioned intrinsic table. Candidate: composition and the UVB canonical binary are executable by reference tools today; the verifier and the kernel are not, and no adapter publishes a lowered corpus yet, so its hashes are admission-only evidence rather than a compatibility guarantee.

envelope.facets: ordered [facetKey, value] pairs for every present facet
envelope.absentFacets: ordered facetKey list for every optional facet the composition did not produce

numeric.model: gameplay values are i64 and fixed64 (Q32.32, SPEC_UV_FIXED_POINT) integer quanta only; the canonical form encodes them as integers, never as decimal rationals
numeric.float32Widening: not applicable: no float32 exists in this plane; a presentation-marked f64 field never enters the hash
numeric.negativeZero: not applicable to integer quanta; an integer zero has one encoding
numeric.nonFinite: NaN and infinities cannot arise from integer quanta; a lowering that would need one is a named refusal, never a hash
numeric.comparison: equality is byte equality of the canonical encoding; no epsilon exists in this scope, and admission comparisons against decimal references are made at quantum level

missingSemantics.absentFacet: an optional facet (scenarios, behavior) the composition did not produce; it is named in absentFacets and contributes its key, never a fabricated value
missingSemantics.absentKey: forbidden inside a facet value: every key a facet declares is always present
missingSemantics.null: not used by this plane: an optional kind-schema field no layer sets is absent from the resolved definition rather than null
missingSemantics.empty: an empty list is a positive fact (a definition with no tags, a composition with no mods), never a stand-in for absent
missingSemantics.unknown: this scope defines no unknown sentinel; an unlowerable construct is a named refusal that hashes like any other node
missingSemantics.refusals: UVS refusal actions and lowering refusals are content, not omissions: dropping one silently changes identity

ordering.facets: by facetKey in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.absentFacets: by facetKey in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.objectKeys: by UTF-8 byte order of the key, applied by the canonical form itself
ordering.sequences: layer lists, resolved field lists and bound intrinsic lists are ordered by the rules below; module bodies keep publication order because instruction order is semantic
ordering.layers: by rank (base < official < map < mod), then explicit order, then packageId in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.definitions: by full id in UTF-8 byte order; fields by field name in UTF-8 byte order
ordering.charts: by (composition rank, chart name) — the same order the runtime fires them
ordering.intrinsics: by id@version in UTF-8 byte order

resourceClosure.policy: content-qualified: every layer of a composition is named by its package id, version and canonical content digest; a composition hash is a function of those digests and nothing outside them

modes.logical: package identity only (id@version) — used for dependency resolution, never for the hash
modes.content-qualified: package identity plus the canonical content digest of its ordered contents — the only mode the composition hash accepts

resourceClosure.modeIsHashedRationale: a composition that named packages logically would hash the same across different bytes; content qualification is what makes the run identity a fact
resourceClosure.digestForm: <algorithm>:<lowercase hex>; a bare hex string is rejected

facets.summary: The ordered layer list that produced this run: rank, explicit order, package id, version and content digest per layer.

keys.layers: ordered array of [rank, order, packageId, packageVersion, contentDigest]
keys.root: the root package id and version the composition was requested for

live.note: no live publisher yet: adapters are not built; today the facet is produced by tools/uv-composition.mjs from schema-valid manifests

artifact.note: the composed manifests and their canonical content digests, per SPEC_UVP section 2

facets.summary: Every resolved definition with its effective field values and the layer that set each value.

keys.definitions: ordered array of [fullId, kind, [fieldName, value, provenanceLayer]...]

live.note: no live publisher yet; produced by tools/uv-composition.mjs resolveDefinitions; admission compares it against Modkit resolved values at quantum level

artifact.note: kind-schema, definitions and overlay documents composed in layer order, per SPEC_UVD section 4

facets.summary: Every scenario chart the composition ships, in canonical document form, ordered as the runtime fires them.

keys.charts: ordered array of canonical UVS chart documents keyed by (rank, chart name)

facets.presenceRule: absent when the composition ships no UVS document; a package with no charts contributes nothing here

live.note: no live publisher yet; the verifier that admits charts does not exist

facets.summary: Every behavior module the composition binds, by the identity digest of its canonical binary.

keys.modules: ordered array of [namespace, identityDigest]; the structural JSON never reaches this facet

facets.presenceRule: absent when the composition ships no UVB module

live.note: no live publisher yet; the luau→uvb compiler does not exist

artifact.note: canonical binaries per SPEC_UVB section 2a; the identity digest excludes the source map

facets.summary: The intrinsic ids and versions actually bound at composition, against the registered table.

live.note: no live publisher yet; the requirement check is executed by tools/uv-composition.mjs against runtime/intrinsics.v1.json

liveBaseContract.note: the dependency-free reference composition tool is the only publisher today; a candidate publisher, not an admitted host contract

artifactProfile.marker: a package manifest whose uv block is { format: UVP, version: 1.0 } plus its composed UVD/UVS/UVB contents
artifactProfile.mandatoryMapping: every facet value is a function of manifests and canonical documents; no facet reads anything a package does not ship

notFrozenHere: the kernel state hash algorithm and save section encodings (specs/state) are named by receipts, not by this scope
the UVB verifier's exact diagnostics are named by the Luau frontend draft, not by this scope
media closure (UVM/UVT/UVW) is covered by its own scopes; this scope names media only by role and digest

compatibility.minorVersions: a minor version may add an optional facet or a key with a declared default; hashes across minors are comparable only for the facets both versions declare
compatibility.majorVersions: a major version may change facet ids, encodings, ordering or numeric rules; hashes across majors are never comparable
compatibility.hashComparability: two hashes are comparable when scopeId, major version and the set of present facet keys are equal; otherwise the comparison is undefined and a tool must say so
